facts.text: UMBC's Meyerhoff Scholars Program supports high-achieving high school seniors who intend to pursue doctoral study in STEM fields.

sources.title: Benefits and Eligibility – Meyerhoff Scholars Program – UMBC
sources.quote: The Meyerhoff Scholars Program is open to all high-achieving high school seniors who have an interest in pursuing doctoral study in the sciences, technology, engineering, or mathematics
